author: CBR
description:
Deadpool didn’t get made because a studio believed in it. It got made because Ryan Reynolds basically willed it into existence, down to leaking test footage in costume. Fox wasn’t sure an R-rated, filthy-mouth superhero could work… and the bigger question was, “who even is Deadpool?”
